process_defect_disclosed.what: This snapshot archive was created AFTER the independent validator task (TASK-20260805-234661) was already dispatched, not before, violating this campaign's core sequencing rule that a producer's artifact must be snapshot-archived and dispatcher-verified BEFORE any independent review reads it. The Coordinator caught this immediately after dispatching and archived within minutes, before the validator returned.
process_defect_disclosed.why_it_is_not_worse_than_that: The red team report was already complete and static in the working tree at dispatch time -- the Coordinator had already read it in full and verified several of its claims before dispatching the validator, so there was no risk of the producer revising the artifact after seeing a review, which is the failure mode the sequencing rule exists to prevent. But the RULE was still violated, and the validator was pointed at a receipt path that did not yet exist.
process_defect_disclosed.disposition: Disclosed here rather than silently repaired. The evidence record for this batch will carry this as a defect.

parse_check_performed_by_this_archive_ta.statement: THE ARCHIVE TASK PARSED THE ARTIFACT ITSELF, whole-file, per CORR-20260803-ba2eb7.
